do_not_invent: Never invent archive records: every JAH-GEN ID must resolve against data/index.json.gz or the manifest.
Search returns only real archived records. If nothing matches: NO ARCHIVE MATCH FOUND — never fabricate a record.
Exact-ID lookup returns OUTPUT_NOT_FOUND for unknown IDs.
Never invent: output IDs, seeds, dimensions, materials, test results, CAD models, cross-site relationships, or physical-test claims.
If a field is absent: NOT SPECIFIED. Never estimate silently.

engine.client: SigGen — embedded in index.html (same source as code/engine.js)
engine.content_hash: SigGen.outputHash(o) — sha256 of canonical (sorted-key, UTF-8) output JSON
engine.id_scheme: JAH-GEN-<FAMILY>-<seed zero-padded to 6> (family key uppercased); universal solves JAH-GEN-CUSTOM-<base36 hash>
engine.rng: mulberry32 over 32-bit string hash; no Math.random(), no dates, no network in generation
engine.verify: SigGen.verifyRecord([id, family, seed, name, tagline]) re-solves and compares

generated_vs_measured.CALCULATED: derived by a documented formula from other fields
generated_vs_measured.GENERATED: produced by the seeded deterministic generator — the normal case for ALL numeric fields; never measured
generated_vs_measured.MEASURED: measured from a real prototype/test — requires evidence; no archived output is MEASURED
generated_vs_measured.SOURCE_DERIVED: taken from a cited filed archive record
generated_vs_measured.USER_SUPPLIED: supplied by the user as a parameter override

id_scheme: JAH-GEN-<FAMILY>-<6-digit seed>; JAH-GEN-CUSTOM-<base36 hash>; families JAH-GF-01..JAH-GF-20

safety_labels.concept_simulation: on-page CONCEPT-STATUS banner + JSON-LD disambiguatingDescription: concept simulation — generated design, not engineered, not physically tested, not certified safe
safety_labels.generated_signature_design: every output is framed as a generated Signature design — never a manufactured, tested, or certified product
safety_labels.medical_family: speculative wellness concepts only — not medical advice, not a diagnosis or treatment; explicit on the homepage AND every medical-family record

search_api.note: Search returns only archived records. Query terms match id, name, tagline, family. Exact JAH-GEN-###### lookup supported.
